options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: cert
options.description: Content of the new certificate in PEM format. Each line should be followed by an escape character "\n".

options.name: private_key
options.description: Contents of the private key in PEM format. Only an RSA private key is allowed. The private key can be omitted if the provided certificate is issued based on the CSR generated by /v1/certificates/csr.

options.name: root_cert_chain
options.description: Contents of the certificate chain in PEM format. The root CA certificate comes first, followed by the intermediate CA certificates (if any).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for getting update status, the default value is 600 seconds

options.name: vc_admin_account
options.description: VC admin account for invoke VC API to send the new root cert to VC trust store

options.name: vc_admin_password
options.description: VC admin password for invoke VC API to send the new root cert to VC trust store

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
